name: GitHub Copilot
description: GitHub Copilot is an AI-powered coding assistant that provides contextualized assistance throughout the software development lifecycle, from inline code suggestions and IDE chat to code review and autonomous coding-agent capabilities.
best_for: Positioned for individual developers (free and Pro plans), teams and enterprises needing governance controls (Business/Enterprise plans), and students and open-source maintainers with special pricing tiers.
features: Inline code completion and suggestions based on editor context
Chat assistance for coding questions and explanations inside the IDE
Automated code review of pull requests
Copilot CLI for command-line assistance via GitHub CLI
Coding agent that can autonomously plan, explore, and execute development tasks
Multi-model access, choosing from AI models optimized for speed, accuracy, or cost
Integrations with Visual Studio Code, Visual Studio, JetBrains IDEs, Neovim, and Eclipse

alternatives.name: ChatGPT
alternatives.description: OpenAI's general-purpose AI assistant, including a "Codex" mode for coding with local repos and terminals.
alternatives.best_for: Developers who want one assistant spanning chat, research, and coding rather than an IDE-embedded tool.

alternatives.name: Claude
alternatives.description: Anthropic's AI assistant, used heavily for coding, debugging, and codebase analysis via chat, desktop apps, or API.
alternatives.best_for: Developers wanting a collaborative AI partner for complex coding and analysis tasks.

alternatives.name: Gemini
alternatives.description: Google DeepMind's AI models, including agentic coding assistance integrated with Google's developer tools.
alternatives.best_for: Developers in the Google ecosystem wanting agentic coding with long-context reasoning.
